owner_creation.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: The private lbool owns validity of ch_ungotchar, initially false; a nonnegative pushback call sets it only after copying the byte.
owner_creation.invariant: Validity refers to one initialized pushback payload.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: ch_get reads the flag and copies the payload; neither value keeps the active filestate alive or records the input generation.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Availability does not extend input-state lifetime.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

callback_targets.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: The flag gates data selection, not indirect dispatch; overrun diagnostics call error and can cross display owners before replacement completes.
callback_targets.invariant: A validity bit does not protect diagnostic reentry.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

invalidation.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: Negative ch_ungetchar input cancels validity and ch_get consumes it once; the Boolean does not itself invalidate any stale active-file alias.
invalidation.invariant: Cancelling pushback and deleting an ifile are distinct actions.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: Producer payload/flag and consumer cache-write/flag-clear are multi-step raw operations, not an atomic state-machine commit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Payload publication relies on normal command sequencing.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

release_pair.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: Clearing the bit releases no memory or FD; it only discards a logical pending byte.
release_pair.invariant: Pushback validity owns no external release pair.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.

error_cleanup.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar: An already-valid slot reports an overrun but subsequently replaces its payload; callers must not mistake the bit for a retained error receipt.
error_cleanup.invariant: Availability is not an error-result object.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.
